protocol.selection: First five held-out manifest rows; one per family; no outcome-based selection
protocol.grading: Exact counts/categories; distance tolerance 2 pixels; independent verifier
notes: Same image/question and model settings across modes.
Independently generated plans per mode; whole-system comparison, not isolated selector causality.
Preserve failures and abstentions. No tuning during this cohort.
One attempt per task is exploratory, not statistically conclusive.

preflight_failure.reason: Validator incorrectly rejected citations to the supplied original image. All modes now accept only image IDs actually provided, alongside valid tool evidence IDs. The entire comparison was restarted; original failed outputs are preserved.
preflight_failure.policy_changes: None: models, task cohort, thresholds, prompts and scoring unchanged.

conclusion: Highest observed accuracy: Vanilla Astra, Astra + OpenCV, Tools + Jev selection, Full harness (5/5 correct).
practical_result: Among the accuracy leaders, Vanilla Astra had the lowest observed mean runtime (6.4s). This cohort shows no accuracy benefit from the added layers when vanilla already answers every task correctly.
